notes.title: Tool Mastery
notes.notes: [p][b]Whats new:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The content and storage models have been changed. Now there are separate storages for sticks, logs, stones, and metal ingots.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554583/edda8f0235551f3b9f62187a13b98e100f12cbb4.png"][/img][/p][p]New tools – a two-handed axe and a two-handed pickaxe. Tools now also have durability and break after some time, and metal tools gather resources faster.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554583/c2107de0221bdaf86229fdb8bfbeb65bd959945c.png"][/img][/p][p]A new type of transport – a wagon for carrying logs. Moving logs just got easier![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554583/916c6078a587e970a06bec838e717baf4388caf2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Colossal Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[p]The survival world has become even bigger and more alive! In this update, we’ve added new islands, expanded gameplay mechanics, and made the experience smoother and more immersive.
[/p][p]      [/p][previewyoutube="3gTPSiLRK-A;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[b]What’s new:[/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]New Archipelago![/b] Exploring the world has never been more exciting – run, jump, discover new biomes, and enjoy the enhanced graphics! Marvel at the new flowers, improved trees, rocks, and fresh vegetation. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554583/d733eb1143bd74cd70656caa32b81b57033fab40.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Shells and new natural objects[/b]. Small details make the world feel alive – collect shells, check out a variety of bushes, stumps, and other environmental objects. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554583/f8d0cdc23e86255ed17ea8be4ef82ebd35ff4611.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]New resource gathering system.[/b] Collecting resources is now more engaging: stones break into smaller pieces, and branches and tree trunks must be chopped separately. [/p][/*][*][p][b]New trees[/b] – Birch and Pine. They drop new types of logs, opening up even more crafting possibilities.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554583/af811c9e00457b0fa28800e524e9043e4e2b2441.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Recipes displayed on the tablet.[/b] The tablet now has a new recipes tab for easier crafting planning.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554583/ca9a55cfe1bfa68af1eb36024a21c3f396e096b4.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]A bit of balance.[/b] Crops now grow slower – you won’t be able to fill your pockets quickly anymore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save system.[/b] Finally, you don’t have to worry about progress – all your data is now safely stored! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Project optimization.[/b] The game runs smoother, even in complex locations. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Immersive sounds![/b] We’ve added new sounds for mountain tops, water immersion, and footsteps. Forests, fields, and snowy biomes now transition smoothly, enhancing the sense of presence in the wild. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoother movement.[/b] Falling from heights is now faster, and jumping feels more natural and comfortable. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fixes.[/b] The game keeps getting more stable, with fewer bugs every update![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: We're Keeping the Demo Open! 🚀
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We have some exciting news: [b]we're leaving the demo of our game open even after the Steam Next Fest ends![/b] 🎮[/p][p]We received an overwhelming response during the event, and we want to keep the momentum going. We believe in the potential of this game, and we're thrilled to let more players experience it before the official release.[/p][p]Whether you missed the festival or just want to dive back in, [b]you can still try out the demo for free anytime[/b] on our Steam page![/p]

notes.title: 🔥 SteamVR integrated and bugs fixed!
notes.notes:
[p]Thought VR was complicated? Hell no! We integrated SteamVR into the project and smashed all launch issues. Now the game runs smooth, no freezes or glitches — just pure fun and full immersion.[/p][p]If you used to get stuck on loading — forget about that. Test it, break it, demand more! Because we’re not stopping here.[/p][p]Are you ready to dive into VR, or will you keep staring at the screen like a cabbage?[/p][p]
Hit “Update” and don’t waste time. Move forward — VR is waiting![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes: DEMO LAUNCH
notes.notes:
🎉 We did it!
The demo is live on Steam. This isn’t just an update — it’s the beginning of something big, and you’re one of the first to step in.
We poured time, sweat, and just a bit of madness into this. Now it’s your turn to push the button and say, "Damn, it runs!"

⚠️ Attention!
This is a demo. It’s fresh, raw, and maybe a little wild.
Yes, bugs may exist.
We know. You’ll feel them. And your feedback? Pure gold.
Report, rant, screenshot — we’re listening.

🧠 What’s next?
More content. More chaos. More gameplay.
This is just the beginning. And now you’re part of it.

👊 Download. Play. Break things. Come back.
